steps.title: Set up Python environment
steps.instruction: Setup Before you proceed with any of the steps, ensure you have Python installed. Step 1: Set up the Python environment. Use the requirements.txt file to install the necessary packages. python -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate # On Windows, use: venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt 2. Dataset Creation To create the dataset, navigate to the dataset_creation directory and execute the Jupyter Notebook titled dataset_notebook.ipynb. cd dataset_creation jupyter notebook dataset_notebook.ipynb Follow the instructions inside the notebook to generate the dataset required for training. 3. Training the Neural Network The neural network is trained using the run.py file located in the NeuralNetwork directory. Note: Training can be resource-intensive. In our experiments, we utilized the SLURM job scheduler for this purpose. Due to the high resource demand, we haven't provided a training example within the network_notebook.ipynb. However, you can examine a sample model and understand the training procedure by looking through the provided file.

substeps.instruction: Create virtual environment with `python -m venv venv`
Install required packages using `pip install -r requirements.txt`
Change directory to the dataset folder: `cd dataset_creation`
Launch the dataset notebook: `jupyter notebook dataset_notebook.ipynb`
Follow the notebook instructions to generate the training dataset
Run the neural network training script `run.py` in the NeuralNetwork directory (training is resource‑intensive; use SLURM scheduler if available)
